angleRead.text: Angela Reyes plans to explore why KONO's school quality index remains stagnant at 7 despite stable citywide metrics, focusing on the human elements behind the numbers. With no educators on the ledger in KONO, she'll contrast the neighborhood's 46-student reality with Rockridge's thriving 230-student environment, seeking the untold pressures in a system where funding and outcomes don't align.

plan.chase: Angela Reyes plans to explore why KONO's school quality index remains stagnant at 7 despite stable citywide metrics, focusing on the human elements behind the numbers. plan.focus: The disconnect between KONO's stable-but-low school quality index and the lived experience of its 46 students, despite unchanged citywide metrics.
plan.why: KONO's stagnation at index 7 stands out when enrollment is shifting elsewhere and the district shows growth. The absence of educators on the ledger suggests a story about systemic invisibility.
